items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: And even Narada Michael Walden, they were all in there together. And I came in right after they left

ctx.x: And they were with Sri Chinmoy. That’s where Santana gets all its spirituality from. And even Narada Michael Walden, they were all in there together. And I came in right after they left and that’s what I found out — you know meditation really works. And then Sri Chinmoy used to have vegetarian restaurants and health food stores. So you know I always tried to stay on top of taking care of yourself. Because you know musicians, right, if you study musicians back in the day now you say were they spiritual, they were…
Is there anything these days that makes you angry?
